enriched_activities.desc: Lie face down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the shoulders. Turn the head to the left side. Bend the right arm under the pillow. Remain still with eyes closed. Roll onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Extend the left leg. Bend the right knee. Turn onto the back. Place both arms along the sides. Turn the head to the right. Remain motionless with slow breathing. Roll onto the left side. Tuck the left hand under the pillow. Stretch both legs down. Remain still until the alarm rings.

Press the alarm button on the phone to stop it. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Press the light switch. Turn the shower tap to the hot side. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body with water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Rinse off the soap. Turn the shower tap off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Rub the towel over the hair and body. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Press the light switch off. Open the door and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and setting the dishwasher on a delayed start for the free midday electricity window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on the counter. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Put two slices of bread on the plate. Pick up a knife. Spread butter on the bread. Pick up a glass from the cupboard. Pour milk into the glass. Pick up the plate and glass. Carry them to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the bread. Take a bite. Chew and swallow. Drink milk from the glass. Finish the bread. Stand up. Carry the plate and glass to the sink. Rinse the plate and glass. Place them on the drying rack. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the bottom rack. Load the breakfast plate and glass. Push the rack back in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the delay start button. Press the button repeatedly to set the 12:00 start time. Press the start button.

Pick up the work bag from the chair. Walk to the front door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the path to the car. Press the key fob button to unlock the car. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Place the bag on the passenger seat. Fasten the seat belt. Insert the key in the ignition. Turn the key to start the engine. Press the button to lower the window slightly. Shift the gear lever to drive. Press the accelerator pedal. Steer the car out of the driveway. Drive along the street. Stop at the traffic light. Press the indicator lever. Turn the steering wheel right. Continue driving. Park the car in the hospital car park. Turn the key to stop the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the driver door. Step out. Pick up the bag. Close the door. Lock the car with the key fob. Walk toward the hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a day shift at the hospital, providing patient care and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk through the hospital entrance. Swipe the badge at the staff door. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the scrubs. Change into the scrubs. Close the locker. Walk to the ward. Pick up the handover sheet. Read the patient list. Walk to the first patient room. Knock on the door. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap it around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the reading. Remove the cuff. Pick up the thermometer. Place it under the patient's tongue. Remove it and read the number. Open the medication drawer. Take out the medication cup. Hand it to the patient. Pick up the water cup. Hand it to the patient. Write the observation on the chart. Walk to the next patient room. Repeat the checks. Sit at the nurses' station. Open the computer. Type the clinical notes. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the supply room. Pick up gloves and dressings. Carry them to the treatment room. Open the dressing pack. Put on gloves. Clean the wound. Apply the new dressing. Remove the gloves. Throw them in the bin. Wash the hands at the sink. Walk back to the ward. Answer the phone at the nurses' station. Write down the message. Walk to the patient room. Adjust the IV drip rate. Check the infusion pump. Sit at the computer. Update the patient record. Save the file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the cafeteria. Pick up a tray. Place the tray on the rail. Pick up a plate. Spoon rice onto the plate. Pick up the tongs. Place vegetables on the plate. Place chicken on the plate. Pick up a bowl. Fill it with soup. Place the bowl on the tray. Pick up a bottle of water. Place it on the tray. Walk to the cashier. Hand the staff card to the cashier. Take the card back. Carry the tray to a table. Set the tray down. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Cut the chicken. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the bottle. Continue eating the rice and vegetables. Finish the soup. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return belt. Place the plate and bowl on the belt. Place the tray on the stack. Walk out of the cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing the day shift at the hospital, attending to patients and handing over cases
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back to the ward. Pick up the handover sheet. Walk to the first patient room. Knock. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Check the IV line. Press the buttons on the infusion pump. Record the numbers on the chart. Walk to the next patient room. Help the patient sit up. Move the pillow behind the back. Pick up the walking frame. Place it in front of the patient. Support the patient's arm. Walk beside the patient to the chair. Lower the patient into the chair. Walk back to the bed. Straighten the sheet. Pull up the blanket. Walk to the nurses' station. Pick up the telephone. Answer the call. Write the order on the notepad. Walk to the medication room. Open the cabinet. Take out the medication vials. Check the labels. Prepare the medication in the tray. Carry the tray to the patient room. Hand the medication to the patient. Pick up the water cup. Hand it to the patient. Record the dose on the chart. Walk to the supply room. Restock the gloves in the drawer. Carry the empty boxes to the bin. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit at the computer. Open the patient records. Type the handover notes. Save the file. Print the handover sheet. Pick up the printed sheet from the printer. Walk to the oncoming nurse. Hand the sheet over. Read the notes aloud. Point to the patient list. Answer the questions. Shake hands. Walk to the locker room.

Open the locker. Change out of the scrubs. Put on the street clothes. Hang the scrubs in the locker. Close the locker. Pick up the work bag. Walk out of the locker room. Walk through the hospital corridor. Push the exit door open. Walk to the car park. Press the key fob to unlock the car. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Place the bag on the passenger seat. Fasten the seat belt. Insert the key in the ignition. Turn the key to start the engine. Shift the gear lever to drive. Press the accelerator pedal. Steer the car out of the car park. Drive along the road. Stop at the traffic light. Press the indicator lever. Turn the steering wheel left. Continue driving. Turn onto the home street. Park the car in the driveway. Turn the key to stop the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the driver door. Step out. Pick up the bag. Close the door. Lock the car with the key fob. Walk to the front door. Unlock the door with the key. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the work clothes to the bathroom. Place them in the laundry basket. Push the bathroom door open. Press the light switch. Turn the shower tap to the hot side. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Rinse off the soap. Turn the shower tap off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Rub the towel over the hair and body. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the clean clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Press the light switch off. Open the door and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then emptying the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Place the food on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the board. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the chicken to the pan. Stir again. Press the power button to turn off the cooker. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Spoon the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the glass. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate. Place the plate on the drying rack. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the bottom rack. Take out the clean plates. Place them in the cupboard. Take out the clean glasses. Place them in the cupboard. Take out the clean cutlery. Place them in the drawer. Push the rack back in. Close the dishwasher door.

Walk to the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Sit down on the sofa. Place the remote on the armrest. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the unlock button. Swipe the screen. Open the messaging app. Type a message. Press send. Place the phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Watch the screen. Lean back against the sofa cushion. Cross the legs. Pick up the glass of water from the table. Drink. Place the glass back on the table. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button again. Watch the screen. Stretch both arms. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the glass. Walk to the kitchen. Rinse the glass. Place it on the drying rack. Walk back to the living room. Press the power button on the remote. Turn the TV off. Place the remote on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry, washing and drying work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Pick up the laundry basket. Carry it to the washing machine. Open the washing machine door. Pull out the work clothes. Place them into the drum. Pick up the detergent bottle. Unscrew the cap. Pour detergent into the cap. Pour the detergent into the drawer. Close the drawer. Close the washing machine door. Press the power button. Press the program button to select the wash cycle. Press the start button. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Wash the hands with soap. Rinse the hands. Dry the hands with the towel. Wait for the wash cycle. Press the pause button when the cycle ends. Open the washing machine door. Pull out the wet clothes. Place them into the dryer. Close the dryer door. Press the power button on the dryer. Press the start button. Walk to the shelf. Pick up the clean towels. Fold the towels. Place the towels in the cupboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing meals for the next day and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the food on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the board. Pick up the lunch box from the cupboard. Open the lid. Spoon rice into the box. Place the vegetables into the box. Place the chicken into the box. Close the lid. Place the lunch box in the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the pan. Carry the pan to the sink. Turn on the tap. Scrub the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Place the pan on the drying rack. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Wipe the stove top. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Pick up the broom. Sweep the kitchen floor. Pick up the dustpan. Sweep the dirt into the dustpan. Empty the dustpan into the bin. Place the broom and dustpan back in the corner. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying on the computer for professional development
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen. Type the password on the keyboard. Press enter. Open the browser. Click the bookmark for the course page. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Click the play button on the video. Watch the video. Pick up the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write notes on the page. Place the pen down. Click the next lesson. Watch the video. Type notes in the document. Press the save key. Scroll through the course page. Click the quiz link. Read the question. Click the answer option. Click submit. Read the score. Close the browser. Open the document file. Type a summary paragraph. Press the save key. Press the shutdown button. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time hygiene routine and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Press the light switch. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Pick up the face wash. Squeeze face wash into the palm. Rub it over the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the brush. Run it through the hair. Place the brush on the shelf. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the alarm setting. Set the alarm for 05:45. Place the phone on the shelf. Press the light switch off. Open the door and walk out.

Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the right side. Place the left arm under the pillow. Close the eyes. Remain still. Roll onto the back. Place both arms along the sides. Turn the head to the left. Bend the right knee. Straighten the right leg. Roll onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain motionless. Breathe slowly. Remain still with eyes closed.
